name: How to Convert PDF to JPG
description: Export every PDF page as a high-quality JPG or PNG image — free, no upload.

step.name: Open your PDF
step.text: Click 'Choose files' or drag your PDF into the drop zone.

step.name: Choose format and quality
step.text: Select JPG or PNG output format and choose your preferred resolution (72, 150 or 300 DPI).

step.name: Download the images
step.text: Click 'Convert to JPG'. Each page exports as a separate image file, bundled in a ZIP for easy download.
